pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with soft-edged pixel gradients. Geometries vary from compact sub-hexagons on the neck to more elongated and irregular shapes on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial lines forming a topological grid. Junctions are primarily tri-point and quadri-point nodes. Line thickness is narrow and relatively uniform relative to patch area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark brown mane profile visible along the superior neck margin, displaying a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.
